title: Alwida Mai Ja Raha
body:
alwida khairul wara mai jaa raha hoo karbala
tujhse ab hone juda mai jaa raha hoo karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
martaba mera zamane ko dikhaya aap ne
meri khaatir ya nabi sajda badhaya aap ne
sehne ab jor o jafa mai jaa raha hoo karbala
alwida khairul wara...
<<DIVIDER>>
turbat e zehra pe aa ke shaah e karbal ne kaha
chod kar ab qabr teri deen par hone fida
maa meri khairunnisa mai jaa raha hoo karbala
alwida khairul wara...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e ruqsat aap se hai bas yehi kehna mujhe
saaya ban kar fatema sughra pe rehna hai tujhe
mere bhaiya mujtaba mai jaa raha hoo karbala
alwida khairul wara...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se apne charagh e deen jalana hai mujhe
farsh ko arsh e moalla se milaana hai mujhe
farz ye karne ada mai jaa raha hoo karbala
alwida khairul wara...
<<DIVIDER>>
wan zameer insano ki yehi banegi dars gaah
ye batayega jahan ko rayt par sajda mera
keh raha hoo barmala mai jaa raha hoo karbala
alwida khairul wara...
author: Zameer Hussain
